note: Re-judged 2026-09-30 under ruling R40. Forbidden: mapping a non-egress FEC with no existing mapping, and passing its label upstream, before a label from the downstream LSR arrives. TestRFC5036NonEgressFECNotMappedBeforeDownstreamLabel holds the negative: a non-egress FEC with only a third-party binding is not mapped and no label is sent upstream. TestRFC5036EgressFECMappedWithoutWaiting is the positive: the wait binds only non-egress FECs, so the egress FEC is mapped at once, and an implementation that refused every mapping goes red. The sentence is a prohibition; mapping a transit FEC once the downstream label arrives is not an obligation of this sentence, and transit mapping remains a Support-remaining gap of rfc5036. Re-read 2026-10-23: the positive unit now binds the egress FEC through mustEnsureLocal because LIB.EnsureLocal returns an error on label exhaustion; the assertions are unchanged.
